content: Human-labeling session — combat-divide-and-conquer:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a combat engagement against three enemy teams. You are given 4 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) staged in either the north corridor (y=4..7) or the south corridor (y=33..36) depending on seed, plus a Construction Yard at our rear in the same corridor. The arena is split into three lanes — north (y=2..8), middle (y=17..23), south (y=32..37) — by impassable walls; an open west sliver connects them. Three enemy teams (3 units each, AttackAnything orders) sit at x=28, one in each corridor (NE, MID, SW). Kill all 9 enemies, keep at least 3 tanks alive, and hold the Construction Yard, all within 3000 ticks.
